acceptanceCriteria: Static edges from templates and components (a href, ui-sref, routerLink, link_to/button_to, form actions, programmatic navigate/redirect) are added to the screen graph with provenance 'static', distinct from test-observed and ledger-proven edges.
Router dialect coverage is extended per a measured adopter need; unsupported dialects abstain.
Builds on the ANL Playwright navigation-events reporter and the crawl ticket V1-1191 rather than a second capture path; static edges stay distinct from observed ones.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. Screen-graph edges come only from flow steps, test sequences or the ANL ledger; links in templates/components (anchors, router-links, ui-sref, navigate(), link_to, redirects) are not mined.
title: Site knowledge 4: mine link and navigation edges from templates and components, widen router dialects
